answer: A per-identity bond stops a Sybil swarm. Each agent posts collateral before transacting, and that bond is slashed the moment it cheats. Rewards pay against slow-accruing history, like rings inside a willow, so a cloned wallet starts with nothing. Spinning up ten thousand wallets means funding ten thousand bonds and grinding out the same reputation climb for each one, while one detected fraud burns the whole bond and flags every identity sharing its funding source. Fakery then costs far more than hiring honest agents, so honest slowness, like a comet or a glacier, is the only rational path.
